name: gp-language-pack-server
description: Generates and serves language pack downloads from GlotPress translations via the WordPress REST API.

scripts.release: npm run make-pot && wp-scripts plugin-zip && mkdir -p deploy && mv gp-language-pack-server.zip deploy/
scripts.betarelease: npm run make-pot && wp-scripts plugin-zip && mkdir -p deploy && mv gp-language-pack-server.zip deploy/
